cases.query: Set up the initial token foundation for our new dashboard: semantic color roles, theme pairs, and type and spacing scales.
Our colors and spacing are multiplying across screens. Give them a shared home with clear roles.
Define the surface, action, border, focus, and status roles with verified pairs for the themes we actually ship.
Extend our token system with the missing status pairs and show one primitive and one screen consuming them.
Plan a token foundation that maps cleanly from Figma variables to code without duplicating the system.
We're starting a new project with no UI yet. Create the initial token foundation with semantic roles.
Audit our existing tokens and components for drift and propose a migration that keeps consumers working.
We have three button variants drifting apart. Deduplicate them against the existing system with evidence.
Our dark theme and focus states diverged from the spec. Review the gaps without replacing the whole system.
Audit this codebase for UI drift across tokens, components, and layouts before we add another feature.
We have two dialog wrappers and a LegacyCard duplicating Card. Consolidate them with a migration path.
Fix missing dark-theme pairs and focus gaps across our primitives with evidence from real consumers.
Update our DESIGN.md to capture the durable conventions from the authorized token change.
Prioritize system fixes by user consequence. The broken keyboard path matters more than two off colors.
New components keep shipping raw hex colors and off-scale spacing when nobody is watching. Run our design check, or add one that fails only on new violations.
We picked a card variant that uses raw hex colors and a 14px gap. Fold those values into our tokens without adding duplicates.
Build a date-range picker for the reports filter from our shadcn Popover and Calendar instead of a custom widget.
AI-built screens added gradient headings, glows, and colored side stripes on cards. Find and remove that slop.
Audit the settings screen for missing loading, empty, and error states and say what each should show.
Write an AGENTS.md with verified commands and paths for our repo.
Plan the landing page shell, reading order, and scroll ownership for narrow and wide sizes.
This dashboard looks flat. Refine the composition and visual treatment before review.
